title: Wales's all-time top scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Wales in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Robert Earnshaw: Robert Earnshaw, Cliff Jones and Mark Hughes are joint 9th with 16; any two fill the last two places.
notes.Cliff Jones: Cliff Jones, Robert Earnshaw and Mark Hughes are joint 9th with 16.
notes.Mark Hughes: Mark Hughes, Robert Earnshaw and Cliff Jones are joint 9th with 16.
notes.John Charles: John Charles is joint 12th with 15, just outside.
notes.Kieffer Moore: Kieffer Moore is joint 12th with 15, just outside.
notes.Gareth Bale: Gareth Bale has 41 by the FAW's count (Transfermarkt lists 40).

checks: Wikipedia's records page as it stood on 11 June 2026 (updated to 6 June 2026, Wales's last match before the cut-off; Wales were not at the World Cup) and RSSSF agree on every figure. Transfermarkt agrees for the modern players except Bale (40, against 41) and has incomplete older data; it confirms Wilson 17 and Moore 15 at the cut-off. Earnshaw, Cliff Jones and Mark Hughes share 9th on 16, so the last two places are a pool.
